tools.name: insurance_company
tools.description: Look up EU insurance company by name or LEI number. Returns GLEIF registration status, country, address, and Wikidata enrichment.

tools.name: insurance_news
tools.description: Insurance industry news by topic. Topics: solvency, life, health, property, liability, auto, reinsurance, regulation, natcat, cyber, claims, dora.

tools.name: natcat_live
tools.description: Live natural catastrophe alerts worldwide from GDACS. Returns earthquakes, floods, cyclones, wildfires sorted by severity.

tools.name: earthquake_risk
tools.description: Real-time earthquake data from USGS. Filter by time period, minimum magnitude, and proximity to a location.

tools.name: weather_risk
tools.description: 7-day weather risk assessment for any location. Returns storm, flood, and wind risk with insurance recommendations.

tools.name: natcat_history
tools.description: Historical natural catastrophe statistics for risk modeling. Significant events by type.

tools.name: solvency_check
tools.description: Solvency II compliance news and GLEIF registration status for an insurer.

tools.name: insurance_regulation
tools.description: EU and German insurance regulatory news and updates. Topics: general, bafin, eiopa, idd, gdpr, dora, ifrs17, sustainability, consumer.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Combined location risk score (0-100) for underwriting: earthquake + weather/storm + NatCat proximity.

tools.name: insurance_glossary
tools.description: Explain insurance and Solvency II terms in German or English. Covers: SCR, MCR, ORSA, SFCR, IDD, LEI, NAT CAT, reinsurance, premium, DORA, IFRS 17.

tools.name: claim_news
tools.description: Major insurance claim news by event type: storm, flood, earthquake, hail, fire, cyber.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: InsuranceOracle server status and backend connectivity check.
